classification.difficultyReason: Infer horizontal and vertical displacements from rotated congruent rectangles, accounting for overlapping widths, then form and solve two equations.

content.prompt: The rectangles in each question are all congruent. How long and wide are each of these rectangles?

spec.description: Three unshaded congruent rectangles in a stepped arrangement, with shared edges, one vertical rectangle and two horizontal rectangles. Open corner markers retain the supplied coordinate labels. No axes or grid.
spec.mathematics: For rectangle length L and width W, the horizontal displacement is 2L-W and the vertical displacement is L+2W. The labelled points give displacements 12 and 11.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source corner coordinates are visible; dimensions and equations are withheld.

answer.worked:
Let $L$ be the length and $W$ the width, in coordinate units. The horizontal and vertical displacements give
$$\begin{align*}
2L-W&=13-1=12 &&(1)\\
L+2W&=13-2=11 &&(2)\\
4L-2W&=24 &&2\times(1)\\
5L&=35 &&2\times(1)+(2)\\
L&=7\\
2(7)-W&=12 &&\text{Substitute into (1)}\\
W&=2
\end{align*}$$
Each rectangle is 7 units long and 2 units wide.

spec.description: Four unshaded congruent rectangles: a bottom horizontal rectangle, a vertical rectangle rising from its right end, and two adjoining horizontal rectangles across the top. All divisions, shared edges and open corner markers are retained. No axes or grid.
spec.mathematics: For rectangle length L and width W, the horizontal displacement is 3L-W and the vertical displacement is L+2W. The labelled points give displacements 17 and 15.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source corner coordinates are visible; dimensions and equations are withheld.

answer.worked:
Let $L$ be the length and $W$ the width, in coordinate units. The horizontal and vertical displacements give
$$\begin{align*}
3L-W&=19-2=17 &&(1)\\
L+2W&=18-3=15 &&(2)\\
6L-2W&=34 &&2\times(1)\\
7L&=49 &&2\times(1)+(2)\\
L&=7\\
3(7)-W&=17 &&\text{Substitute into (1)}\\
W&=4
\end{align*}$$
Each rectangle is 7 units long and 4 units wide.
